controls: matching physical fusion-plus-branch contrast without teacher
matching previous packet, fusion and physical candidates
evaluation: All nine candidate predictions frozen before independent truth-last scoring. Clean and six practical scenes, DURA-LU primary, DURA-L/raw secondary; cross_date separately from combined cross_rx/cross_both, same physical IDs. success: Aim for more than 2 pp above ordinary PL in clean and each practical DURA-LU scene and improvement over Tri, preserving individual seed, scene and subgroup regressions. No single exposed setting can establish all-settings success.
